advisoryFindings.title: Add positive template marker coverage
advisoryFindings.improvement: The R4 test covers the retained `[no templates]` marker, but it does not assert the output for a preset that actually has templates. Add one assertion for a non-root preset with a `templates/` directory if the public contract includes a distinct available-template marker or marker omission.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The existing test still exercises root formatting, connectors, labels, aliases, scan markers, alphabetical ordering, and missing-base fallback; this is a useful precision improvement rather than a blocker.
